name: Dual Subs
description: Combines two existing text subtitle tracks into a new ASS track: the learned language at the bottom and the native language above it. Works in every Jellyfin client because the result is a normal external subtitle. Bitmap subtitles are skipped.
overview: Dual-language subtitles generated on the server for language learning

versions.changelog: Language pairs are picked from a list of Jellyfin's languages, removing a pair deletes its generated tracks on the next run, and the pair list no longer duplicates itself on every configuration load.
